input.quote: Section 8.3 Termination. This Agreement will terminate on the earlier to occur of (a) the date upon which the last remaining Receivable is paid in full, settled, sold or written off and any amounts received are applied and (b) the Issuer is terminated under Section 8.1 of the Trust Agreement.
input.rationale: This is a securitization transfer and servicing agreement with no subscription term, renewal term or evergreen mechanic. Article VIII fixes a single, self-liquidating term: the Agreement terminates automatically on the earlier of the last Receivable being paid in full/settled/sold/written off or termination of the Issuer under Section 8.1 of the Trust Agreement, with Sections 8.1 and 8.2 giving the Class A Certificateholder optional acquisition/redemption exits. Searches for "renew", "automatically renew", "successive", "extended for" and "unless either party gives notice" return no results, so there is no automatic renewal, no non-renewal notice window and no renewal price-uplift language. There is nothing to shorten or cap, and no exit risk to us as Issuer/Depositor (the Servicer cannot roll the term forward unilaterally). The auto-renewal rule is therefore inapplicable to this deal structure rather than breached; no redline proposed.
